tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Axis._set_formatter converts strings to StrMethodFormatter and callable objects other than TickHelper instances to FuncFormatter, then validates other inputs as Formatter (lib/matplotlib/axis.py:1949-1958). Excluding other TickHelper callables specifically prevents a Locator from slipping through as a formatter. Locator setters enforce Locator types. This separates responsibilities while retaining the supported string/callable formatter convenience API.

checked_claims.reason: Reads values and compatibility before assignment; failure aborts rather than permits switch.

material_errors: Speculates that failing compatibility check permits incompatible switch; no evidence of inconsistent engine assignment.
tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Leaving either LayoutEngine capability as None makes its corresponding property raise NotImplementedError (lib/matplotlib/layout_engine.py:64-95). Callers needing those properties, such as colorbar selection, subplot adjustment and engine compatibility checks, consequently abort unless they catch the error. set_layout_engine("none") reads both properties while constructing its placeholder, and compatibility checks read colorbar_gridspec before switching (lib/matplotlib/figure.py:2659-2676,2724-2738). This is a fail-fast subclass contract, not evidence that an incompatible switch succeeds.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: get_alpha delegates to super().get_alpha() and returns 1 if AttributeError is raised (lib/matplotlib/colorizer.py:393-397). The code alone does not establish a significant rendering bottleneck. Profile the actual hierarchy and Python version before changing it. Any optimization must preserve AttributeError fallback from both method lookup and execution; simply replacing the try block with an existence check can change that behavior. Without measured evidence, retaining this small fallback is the source-supported choice.

tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: FixedAxisArtistHelper.get_tick_iterators reads _grid_info["lon" or "lat"]["ticks"][side], then yields each tick’s loc and label (lib/mpl_toolkits/axisartist/grid_helper_curvelinear.py:115-134). GridFinder creates those nested dictionaries and attaches labels directly to ticks (lib/mpl_toolkits/axisartist/grid_finder.py:201-221). AxisArtist consumes the yielded data to set tick locations/angles and label locations/text (lib/mpl_toolkits/axisartist/axis_artist.py:937-948). Changing this shared schema therefore requires coordinated updates or can change displayed ticks or raise missing-key/type errors.
